label: 카카오모먼트 Kakao Moment
terms_note: Only a Kakao Developers app converted to a 비즈 앱 with the owner's identity verification and a granted 추가 기능 신청 may call it; calls use a business token (비즈니스 토큰) with the required business consent items; Kakao Business terms agreement required. Campaign types creatable via API: 비즈보드 × 전환/방문, 디스플레이 × 전환/방문, 동영상 × 조회, 카카오톡 채널 × 도달, 개인화 메시지 × 도달. Rate limits: app quota page (not read). Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 business token (Kakao Developers biz app with 비즈니스 인증 + Kakao Moment permission)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (Kakao Moment REST API) Confidence: **high** — official Kakao Developers documentation read.
auth: 1. Create a Kakao Developers app → convert to 비즈 앱 → complete the owner's Kakao account identity verification → request the Kakao Moment permission under [앱] > [추가 기능 신청].
2. Obtain a 비즈니스 토큰 (business token) authorized for the required business consent items (비즈니스 인증).
3. Send the token as `Authorization: Bearer` with `adAccountId` header / parameter on each call.

fields.name: business_token
fields.help: Kakao business token (비즈니스 토큰) issued by POST https://kauth.kakao.com/oauth/business/token after the advertiser consents to moment_management in your biz app (https://developers.kakao.com/docs/latest/ko/business-auth/rest-api). No refresh flow; it expires after long non-use.

config_fields.name: ad_account_id
config_fields.help: Kakao Moment ad account number, sent as the `adAccountId` header that campaign and report calls require.

me.note: GET https://kapi.kakao.com/v1/business/tokeninfo: validates the business token and lists its biz_agreements (group MOMENT with ad_account_ids).

list_accounts.note: GET /openapi/v4/adAccounts/pages (0-based page upstream): Kakao Moment ad accounts (ON and OFF) with raw.memberType. Limited to one call per second.

list_campaigns.note: GET /openapi/v4/campaigns for the ad account in the ad_account_id config (adAccountId header; account_id is not sent). `status` filters config (ON, OFF, DEL); raw.systemConfig shows admin stops. The list has no budget (GET /openapi/v4/campaigns/{id} carries dailyBudgetAmount). No paging.

get_report.note: GET /openapi/v4/campaigns/report?campaignId=&start=&end=&metricsGroup=BASIC&timeUnit=DAY&level=CAMPAIGN. campaign_id is required by Kakao (up to 5, comma-separated). Kakao expects yyyyMMdd dates: pass date_from/date_to like 20260901 (end no later than yesterday). One call per 5 seconds per ad account; cost is KRW.

update_budget.note: PUT /openapi/v4/campaigns/dailyBudgetAmount {id, dailyBudgetAmount}: KRW, 50,000 to 1,000,000,000 in steps of 10 (`currency` is ignored); spends money. Not available for reach campaigns (Bizboard, KakaoTalk channel, Daum shopping); lowering it can cut ad group budgets and bids. One call per 5 seconds.

pause_resume.note: PUT /openapi/v4/campaigns/onOff {id, config: OFF|ON} (only campaigns currently ON or OFF; pausing a KakaoTalk channel reach campaign suspends queued messages). Resuming restarts spending. One call per 5 seconds.

evidence: host apis.moment.kakao.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.2 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 6/6 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
